data.title: Flooding remains in Bangkok and 22 provinces
data.description: Flooding continues in parts of Bangkok and 22 provinces, mostly in the Central Plains, but water levels were falling on Monday, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: China’s embassy issues fresh Thailand travel alert over kidnappings, job scams
data.description: China's embassy in Thailand has warned citizens to carefully plan their trips and pay extra attention to transport security following a string of high-profile kidnappings targeting Chinese nationals.

data.title: Rail travel to expand in 5 provinces
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to expand rail-based public transport into five regional provinces, aiming to improve connectivity, attract investment and support economic growth beyond Bangkok.

data.title: Ministry eyes extension to B40 promotion train tickets
data.description: The Transport Ministry is considering extending the 40-baht all-day fare scheme for Bangkok's Red and Purple electric train lines beyond its Nov 30 expiry.

data.title: Dept opposes plan to open mine near world heritage site
data.description: A conservation agency in Phetchaburi has opposed a proposed dolomite mine near Kaeng Krachan World Heritage Site, warning of potential harm to wildlife, water resources and local communities.

data.title: Dolphin conservation efforts broaden
data.description: On the shores of Songkhla Lake, the survival of endangered Irrawaddy dolphins is tied to the livelihoods of the people who share their habitat.

data.title: Probe into brazen Korat encroachment steps up
data.description: A probe into the encroachment of more than 189 rai (about 75 acres) of national forest reserves in Nakhon Ratchasima will accelerate after surveys confirmed it was all protected land.

data.title: Nida poll: Interior Ministry seen facing toughest censure grilling
data.description: The Interior Ministry is expected to face the toughest scrutiny in the coming no-confidence debate, according to a Nida Poll survey, with 45% of the respondents believing the opposition has solid evidence against the 18 targeted cabinet ministers.

data.title: Prachin Buri oil leak suspected
data.description: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is now testing water quality and preparing to contain oil slicks in Prachin Buri after a suspected oil film was detected, amid concerns it could reach the Prachin Buri River.

data.title: Online gambling crackdown  deemed 'ineffective' by ex-MP
data.description: Former Democrat Party MP Sirichoke Sopha has questioned the effectiveness of the Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry's crackdown on online gambling, claiming that five major betting websites remain accessible from Thailand despite the ministry's announcement that it had blocked 945,075 links.

data.title: Experts urge use of 'alternative data' for better credit checks
data.description: As Asean's digital economy accelerates, policymakers and financial leaders are turning to alternative data as a tool to broaden access to credit for businesses and individuals excluded from traditional systems.

data.title: Thais eye nature-positive economic model
data.description: Thailand is seeking to reshape its economic model by making sustainability, biodiversity protection and innovation central to national development.

data.title: Two policemen killed in separate attacks
data.description: Two police were killed in separate attacks in the southern border province of Narathiwat.

data.title: Traders in Khlong Chan Flats rebuild after historic floods
data.description: Small business owners in Khlong Chan Flats have reopened their shops after a week of severe flooding, but mounting debts and lost income are driving calls for urgent government assistance.

data.title: World Bank loans $200m
data.description: Thailand has secured US$200 million (6.7 billion baht) in World Bank financing for clean energy and low-carbon cities, turning its International Monetary Fund (IMF)-World Bank annual meetings into economic opportunities for businesses and communities.

data.title: Flood victims face delays
data.description: Flood victims in Bangkok faced long queues and confusion when seeking compensation on Sunday as registration quotas filled early and residents reported difficulties using the government’s online application.

data.title: River tugboat capsizes in strong current in Ayutthaya
data.description: AYUTTHAYA - A tugboat capsized in turbulent waters where the Pasak and Chao Phraya rivers meet in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya district on Sunday afternoon. The boatman survived.

data.title: Parents take failed China study trip case to CSD
data.description: Parents and teachers have asked the Crime Suppression Division (CSD) to investigate an alleged scheme in which people claiming links to the Office of the Basic Education Commission (Obec) collected money for a study trip to China that never took place.

data.title: Flooding persists in Bangkok, 21 provinces, death toll 80
data.description: Flooding persists in parts of Bangkok and 21 provinces, mostly in the Central Plains, but water levels continue to fall, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation reported on Sunday.

data.title: Widespread rain forecast through Oct 25
data.description: Heavy to very heavy rain is forecast across Thailand through to Oct 25, raising the risk of flash floods, runoff and landslides, the Meteorological Department warned on Sunday.

data.title: Phuket vegetarian festival culminates Sunday night
data.description: PHUKET - This southern tourist island's nine-day vegetarian festival concludes on Sunday with closing parades throughout the day and a final ceremony at night.

data.title: Nida poll: Interior Ministry seen facing toughest censure grilling
data.description: The Interior Ministry is expected to face the toughest scrutiny in the coming no-confidence debate, according to a Nida Poll survey, with 45% of the respondents believing the opposition has solid evidence against the 18 targeted cabinet ministers.

data.title: Chinese criminal fugitive arrested in Bangkok
data.description: A 37-year-old man wanted in China for alleged links to a transnational crime syndicate and money laundering has been arrested in Bangkok.

data.title: Agents nab Chinese fugitive
data.description: A 37-year-old man wanted in China over alleged links to a transnational crime syndicate and money laundering has been arrested in Bangkok.

data.title: Probe into jumbo's death
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered an urgent investigation over the death of a wild elephant suspected of being electrocuted by an electric fence in Loei.

data.title: Nigerians held in drug sting
data.description: Immigration police have arrested two Nigerian men in Bangkok in a cocaine trafficking crackdown, seizing 103 grammes of the drug and equipment allegedly used to dilute it with chalk and baking soda.

data.title: MRTA to review Hat Yai's monorail
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to review Hat Yai's monorail project next year, aiming to update a decade-old study to reflect new conditions and lessons from the 2025 major floods.

data.title: PCD probes Rangsit canal after fish deaths
data.description: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is investigating pollution in Rangsit canal in Pathum Thani after mass fish deaths and reports of dark, foul-smelling water.

data.title: Economic challenges need global action
data.description: Thailand has called for stronger international cooperation to help economies navigate geopolitical tensions, rising energy costs and technological disruption, arguing that global partnerships must turn investment and innovation into tangible benefits for people and businesses.

data.title: Govt fleshes out energy transition plans
data.description: Thailand plans to accelerate its green transition by reducing energy import dependence, attracting private investment and strengthening climate resilience while creating jobs.
